## Purpose
Checks the delete rules (`services/delete_rules`): refusals, detaching and graph clean-up. It makes no Mistral or tool-service calls.

## Behaviour pinned down
- **Rules:**
  - workflow usage includes archived workflows;
  - an activity in use is refused;
  - a library attached to an agent is refused;
  - detaching keeps the agent's other attachments.
- **Through the API:**
  - an activity used by a workflow is not deleted;
  - a tool is detached from its agents, then deleted;
  - a pending version is deleted without checks;
  - a library attached to an agent cannot be deleted;
  - an unattached library is deleted and leaves the graph;
  - deleting an agent removes only the agent;
  - deleting a library document removes its graph slice.

## Fixtures, mocks and external dependencies
- **Data fixtures:** `workflows`, `agents` and `graph` (a stubbed `rag.graph_store`).
- **Service fixtures:** `client` (a TestClient over `app.main.app`) and `tool_service` (a stubbed `tool_resolver`).
- **Also stubbed:** `agent_service`, `library_service` and `get_mistral_client`.

## How to run
`python -m pytest tests/test_delete_rules.py -q`.

None noted.
